description_en: Updates the name or network configuration of a workspace. Only workspaces in the Initialized state can be updated. Status, TenantId, and RegionId are maintained by the server and cannot be modified through this API operation
description_zh: 更新工作空间名称或网络配置。只有状态为 Initialized 的工作空间允许更新。Status、TenantId 和 RegionId 由服务端维护，不允许通过本接口修改
name: UpdateWorkspace

fields.help_en: The updated name of the workspace
fields.help_zh: 更新后的工作空间名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to allow public egress access from the platform. If this parameter is not specified, the original value is retained. Disabling this feature asynchronously cascades to disable the public network switch for agents. Re-enabling this feature does not automatically restore the agent switch. This parameter only controls whether the latest versions of managed and custom agents use the public egress of the platform. It does not control fixed historical versions, model or MCP proxy egress, or the public egress of the user VPC
fields.help_zh: 未传时保留原值。关闭将异步级联关闭 Agent 公网开关；重新开启不自动恢复 Agent 开关。仅控制托管及自定义 Agent 最新版本使用平台公网出口；不控制固定历史版本、模型/MCP 代理出口和用户 VPC 自身公网出口
fields.name: public_egress_enabled

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to allow public ingress access. If this parameter is not specified, the original value is retained. This parameter can be modified together with PublicEgressEnabled and takes effect asynchronously through a unified task. After this feature is disabled, the public ingress for all agent endpoints in the workspace is closed. After this feature is re-enabled, the original public ingress is restored. INNER_DIRECT and user VPC ingress are not affected. Collaboration and Element Web ingress are not controlled by this parameter
fields.help_zh: 未传时保留原值。可与 PublicEgressEnabled 同次修改，通过统一任务异步生效。关闭后工作空间内所有 Agent Endpoint 的公网入口关闭，重新开启后恢复原公网入口；INNER_DIRECT 和用户 VPC 入口不受影响，协作及 Element Web 入口不在控制范围内
fields.name: public_ingress_enabled

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the VPC network
fields.help_zh: 是否开启 VPC 网络
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The list of vSwitch IDs. When the VPC network is enabled, the list must contain at least one vSwitch, and all vSwitches must belong to the VPC specified by VpcId
fields.help_zh: 交换机 ID 列表，开启 VPC 网络时至少包含一个交换机，且所有交换机必须属于 VpcId 指定的 VPC
fields.name: vswitchids

fields.help_en: The ID of the user VPC
fields.name: vpc_id

fields.help_en: The VPC network configuration of the user
fields.help_zh: 用户 VPC 网络配置
fields.name: vpc

fields.help_en: The updated network configuration of the workspace
fields.help_zh: 更新后的工作空间网络配置
fields.name: network_configuration
